infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need camera access to scan meals and barcodes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need access to your photos if you choose an existing image to analyze.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: We need permission to save images if you export or save results.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location to find healthy food places near you.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: CalorieClick reads your sleep, steps, heart rate, and HRV from Apple Health to give you personalized recovery and coaching insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: CalorieClick saves calories, protein, and other nutrients from your scans, and weight from your journey, to Apple Health.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow CalorieClick.ai to access your camera to scan meals and barcodes.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow CalorieClick.ai to access your location to find healthier restaurants nearby.

plugins.healthSharePermission: CalorieClick reads your sleep, steps, heart rate, and HRV from Apple Health to give you personalized recovery and coaching insights.
plugins.healthUpdatePermission: CalorieClick saves calories, protein, and other nutrients from your scans, and weight from your journey, to Apple Health.
